fields.subnational_unit: Gran Valparaiso conurbation (Valparaiso, Vina del Mar and neighbouring communes), Valparaiso Region; urban drinking-water service of the utility ESVAL; decade-long drought
fields.population: households in 10,042 census blocks of the Gran Valparaiso conurbation served by urban drinking water
fields.sample_size: census-block census: 10,042 census blocks (all blocks), with census, utility and regulator indicators of sensitivity and response capacity
fields.effect_measure: fuzzy-logic composite Territorial Water Vulnerability index (0-1) combining sensitivity and response-capacity indicators, with cluster analysis of neighbourhood profiles and a sensitivity analysis; descriptive, no regression
fields.effect_estimate: 4,841 of 10,042 census blocks (48%) exceed the 0.5 vulnerability threshold, mainly through sensitivity factors (supply constraints, coverage of informal settlements, frequency of unscheduled annual outages) and consistently low response capacity (median 0.08 on a 0-1 scale). Cluster analysis identifies neighbourhood profiles with shared drivers of high vulnerability. The discussion places the findings in fragmented Chilean water governance across public and private actors and notes fragmented, hard-to-access information for the sector.
fields.model_type: fuzzy-logic index construction with hierarchical cluster analysis and sensitivity analysis
fields.study_design: cross-sectional spatial composite-index analysis of all census blocks (descriptive; no outcome validation)
fields.risk_of_bias_rating: Some concern (appraised 2026-10-04 on the full text; supersedes the sparse-extraction 'High concern' of 2026-09-28; JBI Cross Sectional items 1-8: Yes,Yes,Yes,Yes,Unclear,Unclear,Unclear,Yes; 5/8 Yes). Basis: all census blocks of a defined conurbation (Yes); setting and utility described (Yes); indicators defined from census, utility and regulator data (Yes); an explicit 0.5 threshold and fuzzy-logic rules (Yes); confounding not applicable to an index and not addressed (Unclear x2); the index is not validated against measured outcomes (Unclear); fuzzy logic with cluster analysis and a stated sensitivity analysis (Yes). Caveat: a composite index rests on the authors' indicator choices and weights.
fields.section: Full text (JSDEWES, web version): Abstract; Introduction; Methods and data (Territorial Water Vulnerability framework, five steps); Results; Discussion; Conclusions
fields.exact_location: Abstract; methods section 3 (steps 0-4); results (vulnerability map, clusters); discussion of governance and data limits

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a cross-sectional composite-index analysis (fuzzy logic, 10,042 census blocks) of territorial water vulnerability in the Gran Valparaiso conurbation, Chile, read in full text 2026-10-04 (open web version). 48% of blocks exceed the vulnerability threshold, driven by supply constraints, informal-settlement coverage and outages with low response capacity; fragmented governance discussed as context, not tested. Descriptive index, no outcome validation.
